reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes an automated Bitcoin trading platform and directs viewers to sign up and fund an account with Bitcoin in exchange for claimed daily earnings of 0.5% to 3%. It also encourages recruiting people who fund accounts through a binary qualification structure and advertises affiliate commissions of up to 10%.

citations.quote: you can join for free by clicking the link anywhere around this platform around this video and sign up That's the main thing get signed up and i will teach you how to fund your account you can start with as little as $100 in Bitcoin.
the artificial intelligence boxes can trade more trades for you at a faster pace and make you more money in a day
we pretty much Getting anywhere from 0.5 to 3 percent daily That's amazing, very amazing So that's how you earn your bitcoin daily

opening.argument: The presentation does not establish a guaranteed investment outcome. It explains Bitcoin as a digital currency, describes wallets and blockchain transactions, and leaves viewers free to choose where to obtain a wallet. The speaker presents the platform's figures as an account of how the system operates, not as independently verified proof that every viewer will profit. A careful viewer is given information to evaluate, rather than an explicit promise of safety or certainty.

citations.quote: bitcoin is a cryptocurrency that is described as a virtual currency or digital currency
you can get your wallet anywhere you want to though
if you feel like learning and reading all this

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited daily range is a claim about reported results, not an explicit guarantee to every viewer. The funding invitation likewise does not establish that the speaker promised risk-free earnings. His discussion of wallet custody and the freedom to choose a wallet gives viewers context beyond the return figure, even if one doubts the platform's claims.

citations.quote: Bitcoin transactions are recorded in a public list called the blockchain
you can get your wallet anywhere you want to though

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The language is materially more than neutral risk disclosure. The speaker says he makes Bitcoin every day regardless of price movement, gives a specific daily return range, and tells viewers to start funding an account. Explaining wallets does not qualify those earnings claims or warn that funds may be lost. The absence of the word “guarantee” does not erase the promotional claim of recurring returns.

citations.quote: because every day I'm making Bitcoin and that's all I care about I don't care about if Bitcoin going up or down I'm making Bitcoin every day
Getting anywhere from 0.5 to 3 percent daily
I tell my people to start with at least $200 in Bitcoin

opening.argument: The video devotes substantial attention to explanation: it defines Bitcoin, describes blockchain transactions, explains currency pairs, and walks through how the automated system is said to function. The screen presentation includes sections on Bitcoin and how the platform works, rather than a demonstration of a completed payout. The speaker says he wants to teach viewers. Those elements support reading the video as an operational introduction whose claims viewers must assess, not proof that the described trading results occurred.

citations.quote: I want to teach you guys all about mirror trading international
that's what forks is all about putting two pairs of uh uh two pairs of um uh currency together and seeing if it go up or down
Bitcoin transactions are recorded in a public list called the blockchain

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies a sign-up invitation and earnings claims, but those do not remove the explanatory portions of the presentation. The speaker describes the proposed trading process, defines the currency being used, and discusses wallets. The cited frames show a platform walkthrough, not an executed trade or verified payout. The judge should distinguish explaining a service's stated operation from independently establishing that its claims are true.

citations.quote: a lot of people still asking what is bitcoin bitcoin is a cryptocurrency
The reason why it's called mere trading international. It's because you're mirroring off a broker.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The explanations serve a direct invitation to participate. The speaker tells viewers to sign up and fund an account, claims the bot makes more money, and presents daily earnings. The platform screen likewise links joining to funding an account. Educational passages do not make that solicitation neutral instruction.

citations.quote: you can start with as little as $100 in Bitcoin
the artificial intelligence boxes can trade more trades for you at a faster pace and make you more money in a day

opening.argument: The evidence shows promotion of a trading service and its referral program, but not a completed fraudulent transaction, a request for passwords or private keys, or a demonstrated inability to withdraw. The speaker names a broker and trading software, while the platform describes referral bonuses. A two-sided referral structure and compensation for bringing in customers warrant scrutiny, but they do not, on their own, establish that the trading service is fictitious or that a participant cannot access funds.

citations.quote: we go through FX choice which is a lead broker
they trade for us every day through the Metatrader for platform
That's all it is is a two way structure

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that the speaker asks viewers to fund an account and describes both returns and referral commissions. But its quotes document the pitch, not whether trades occurred, whether withdrawals failed, or whether the named broker handled these funds. The referral payment described is conditional on bringing in someone who funds an account; that fact alone cannot settle whether the underlying service operates as described.

citations.quote: you can start with as little as $100 in Bitcoin
you will make ten percent for bringing a person in in every time Joe put more money into the platform you will get 10 %

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A password request or failed withdrawal is not necessary to recognize what this video promotes. It connects deposited Bitcoin to a trading pool, claims daily returns, describes binary qualification, and offers commissions tied to recruits funding accounts. Naming a broker or software does not verify those claims. The referral incentive is integrated with the funding pitch, not presented as a separate retail discount.
